quotes.text: Phenomenal! Professional crew! Beautiful views of the city. The entertainment which is a guitar player with a great voice and good choice of music. Our group of ten have been on this cruise a couple times and had the best time! I highly recommend!
It was so romantic with live music and beautiful sunset. We spent wonderful, enjoyable time with family and friends. Thank you excellent service, delicious food and timeless memories.
